botdata.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `botdata` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `persistent_views` tinyint(1) NOT NULL,
  `prefix` text NOT NULL,
  `bot_spam_channel_coastal` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `bot_spam_channel_aurafall` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `bot_type` text NOT NULL,
  `bot_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `server_id_aurafall` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `server_id_coastal` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=3 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

administrators.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `administrators` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `discordID` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `discord_name` text NOT NULL,
  `TierLevel` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `administrators_discordID` (`discordID`) USING HASH
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=10 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
